mapper.select: SELECT DOCUMENT_ID documentId, #{documentType} documentType, ERROR_DESC errorDesc, NOTES notes, CREATEID createdBy, CREATE_DATE createdDate, PROCESS_STATUS processStatus, PREVIOUS_STATUS previousStatus, OBRACCESSIONNUM obraccessionnum, MSHSENDINGFACILITYCLIA mshsendingfacilityclia, MSHFILENAME mshFileName,MSHLABPFI mshLabPfi, OBXLOINCCODE loincCode, CNT_REPRISED count, MAX_REPRISED_DATE lastReprisedDate, provAddress, provLname, provFname, provMname, provSuffix, providerName, provPhone, provNPI FROM ( WITH main_sql AS ( SELECT /* + INDEX( E LAB_DOC_LAFT_PROCES_IDX ) */ E.document_id,E.ERROR_DESC,E.CREATEID,E.CREATE_DATE,E.PREVIOUS_STATUS,E.NOTES,E.PROCESS_STATUS,D.OBRACCESSIONNUM ,D.MSHSENDINGFACILITYCLIA ,D.MSHFILENAME ,D. MSHLABPFI ,D.OBXLOINCCODE, D.ZLRPROVIDERADDRESSLINE1 || ' ' || D.ZLRPROVIDERADDRESSLINE2 || ', ' || D.ZLRPROVIDERCITY || ', ' || D.ZLRPROVIDERSTATE || ', ' || D.ZLRPROVIDERZIPCODE provAddress, D.OBRPROVIDERLASTNAME provLname, D.OBRPROVIDERFIRSTNAME provFname, D.OBRPROVIDERMIDDLENAME provMname, D.OBRPROVIDERNAMESUFFIX provSuffix, D.OBRCALLBACKPHONE provPhone, pkg_trk_common.fn_get_fullname (D.OBRPROVIDERLASTNAME, D.OBRPROVIDERFIRSTNAME, D.OBRPROVIDERMIDDLENAME, D.OBRPROVIDERNAMESUFFIX) as providerName, D.OBRPROVIDERID provNPI FROM NYEHMS_PROCESS_ERRORS E , ${rawTableName} D WHERE E.document_id=D.document_id AND DOCUMENT_TYPE='HIV_LAB' AND ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y' AND PROCESS_STATUS IN (4,7,30) ) SELECT C.*, SUM(CASE WHEN M.PREVIOUS_STATUS IN (6,15,11) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY M.document_id) cnt_reprised, MAX(CASE WHEN M.PROCESS_STATUS IN (6,15,11) THEN M.UPDATE_DATE ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY C.document_id) MAX_reprised_date, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY M.document_id ORDER BY M.CREATE_DATE ) rwnum FROM NYEHMS_PROCESS_ERRORS M , main_sql C WHERE M.document_id=C.document_id ) WHERE rwnum = 1 ORDER BY CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT DOCUMENT_ID documentId, #{documentType} documentType, ERROR_DESC errorDesc, NOTES notes, CREATEID createdBy, CREATE_DATE createdDate, PROCESS_STATUS processStatus, PREVIOUS_STATUS previousStatus, CNT_REPRISED count, MAX_REPRISED_DATE lastReprisedDate FROM ( WITH main_sql AS ( SELECT /* + INDEX( E LAB_DOC_LAFT_PROCES_IDX ) */ E.document_id,E.ERROR_DESC,E.CREATEID,E.CREATE_DATE,E.PREVIOUS_STATUS,E.NOTES,E.PROCESS_STATUS
FROM NYEHMS_PROCESS_ERRORS E , ${rawTableName} D WHERE E.document_id=D.document_id AND DOCUMENT_TYPE=#{documentType} AND ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y' AND PROCESS_STATUS IN (4,25,26,27,28,29,32) ) SELECT C.*, SUM(CASE WHEN M.PREVIOUS_STATUS IN (6,15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY M.document_id) cnt_reprised, MAX(CASE WHEN M.PROCESS_STATUS IN (6,15) THEN M.UPDATE_DATE ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY C.document_id) MAX_reprised_date, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY M.document_id ORDER BY M.CREATE_DATE ) rwnum FROM NYEHMS_PROCESS_ERRORS M , main_sql C WHERE M.document_id=C.document_id ) WHERE rwnum = 1 ORDER BY CREATE_DATE DESC

MSHLABPFI ,D.OBXLOINCCODE

FROM NYEHMS_PROCESS_ERRORS E , ${rawTableName} D WHERE E.document_id=D.document_id AND DOCUMENT_TYPE=#{documentType} AND ACTIVE_FLAG ='N' AND PROCESS_STATUS IN (33) ) SELECT C.*, SUM(CASE WHEN M.PREVIOUS_STATUS IN (6,15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY M.document_id) cnt_reprised, MAX(CASE WHEN M.PROCESS_STATUS IN (6,15) THEN M.UPDATE_DATE ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY C.document_id) MAX_reprised_date, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY M.document_id ORDER BY M.CREATE_DATE ) rwnum FROM NYEHMS_PROCESS_ERRORS M , main_sql C WHERE M.document_id=C.document_id ) WHERE rwnum = 1 ORDER BY CREATE_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE NYEHMS_PROCESS_ERRORS set NOTES = #{p_notes}, UPDATEID = #{p_worker_id}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE where DOCUMENT_ID = #{p_documentId} and ((PROCESS_STATUS in (4, 7, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 32) and ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') or (PROCESS_STATUS in (33) and ACTIVE_FLAG = 'N'))
mapper.select: select S.DOCUMENT_ID documentId, 'HIV_LAB' documentType, PS.PROCESSES_STATUS_DESC processStatusDesc, PS.PROCESSES_STATUS_CODE processStatus from STD_HIV_ECLRS_DOC S, CODED_LAB_PROCESSES_STATUS PS where PS.PROCESSES_STATUS_CODE = S.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS and S.CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS in (7, 8, 9, 10)
select ADDRESS_ID, ADDRESS, FLAG_ACTIVE , FILTER_TYPE, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') CREATE_DATE, TO_CHAR(END_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') END_DATE from RAW_ADDR_CANBE_RES
mapper.insert: insert into RAW_ADDR_CANBE_RES(ADDRESS, FLAG_ACTIVE, FILTER_TYPE, CREATE_UID, CREATE_DATE) values(upper(trim(#{p_address})), 'Y', #{p_filterType}, #{p_workerId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: update RAW_ADDR_CANBE_RES set FLAG_ACTIVE = #{flag_active}, END_DATE = SYSDATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY = #{p_workerId} where ADDRESS_ID = #{addressId}
mapper.select: select ERROR_DESC from NYEHMS_PROCESS_ERRORS where document_id = #{docId} and ACTIVE_FLAG ='Y' and rownum < 2
select count(*) from RAW_ADDR_CANBE_RES where FLAG_ACTIVE = 'Y' and ADDRESS = upper(trim(#{p_address})) and FILTER_TYPE =#{p_filterType}

SELECT c.ERROR_CATEGORY, c.ERROR_TYPE, c.ERROR_DESC, COUNT(a.document_id) COUNT FROM nyehms_owner.nyehms_process_errors a, nyehms_owner.nyehms_process_errors_detail b, nyehms_owner.coded_process_errors c WHERE a.error_id = b.error_id AND b.error_code = c.error_code AND a.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' and PROCESS_STATUS in (4 , 7, 30)
GROUP BY c.ERROR_CATEGORY, c.ERROR_TYPE, c.ERROR_DESC ORDER BY 1

select l.laft_staff, raw1.mshsendingfacilityclia CLIA, raw1.mshlabpfi PFI, l.lab_name LAB_NAME, COUNT(*) COUNT from raw_hiv_Eclrs_Doc raw1, lab_physical_facility l where exists ( select 1 from nyehms_process_errors where
ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' and PROCESS_STATUS in (4 , 7, 30)
and error_desc is not null and document_type = 'HIV_LAB' and raw1.document_id = document_id ) and raw1.mshlabpfi = To_Char(l.pfi(+)) group by l.laft_staff, raw1.mshsendingfacilityclia, raw1.mshlabpfi, l.lab_name order by l.lab_name

SELECT L.LAB_NAME, r.mshsendingfacilityclia CLIA, r.mshlabpfi PFI, usr.LEGACY_UID UPDATEID, Sum(CASE WHEN PROCESS_STATUS IN (6,15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) REPRISE_CNT, Sum(CASE WHEN PROCESS_STATUS IN (33) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DELETE_CNT, Sum(CASE WHEN PROCESS_STATUS IN (20) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) EDIT_CNT FROM nyehms_users usr, RAW_HIV_ECLRS_DOC R, NYEHMS_PROCESS_ERRORS N, LAB_PHYSICAL_FACILITY L WHERE R.document_id = N.document_id AND R.MSHLABPFI = TO_CHAR(l.PFI(+)) and n.UPDATEID = usr.worker_id and N.PROCESS_STATUS IN (6,15,33,20) and UPDATE_DATE between To_Date(#{fromDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') AND To_Date(#{toDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY')+1 group by L.LAB_NAME, r.mshsendingfacilityclia , r.mshlabpfi , usr.LEGACY_UID order by LAB_NAME asc

SELECT CREATE_DATE, case when mon_name = 'DEC' and week = '01' then to_number(Year) + 1 else to_number(year) end || week YEAR_WEEK, MON_NAME, DAY_NAME, REPRISE_DELETE, UPDATEID, TO_CHAR(count(*)) COUNT FROM ( SELECT to_char(n.UPDATE_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') CREATE_DATE, to_char(n.UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY') YEAR, to_char(n.UPDATE_DATE, 'IW') WEEK, to_char(n.UPDATE_DATE, 'MON') MON_NAME, to_char(n.UPDATE_DATE, 'DAY') DAY_NAME, CASE WHEN PROCESS_STATUS IN (6,15) THEN 'REPRISE' WHEN PROCESS_STATUS IN (20) then 'EDIT' ELSE 'DELETE' END REPRISE_DELETE, usr.LEGACY_UID UPDATEID --TO_CHAR(count(*)) COUNT
FROM NYEHMS_PROCESS_ERRORS N, nyehms_users usr WHERE n.UPDATEID = usr.worker_id and N.PROCESS_STATUS IN (6,15,33,20) and n.document_Type = 'HIV_LAB' and usr.LEGACY_UID not in ('SKA03', 'NYEHMS', 'JAS22', 'JLC16','VZG03') and UPDATE_DATE between To_Date(#{fromDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') AND To_Date(#{toDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY')+1 ) group by create_date, case when mon_name = 'DEC' and week = '01' then to_number(Year) + 1 else to_number(year) end || week, mon_name , day_name, REPRISE_DELETE, UPDATEID order by to_date(create_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY')

select errDtl.ERROR_ID, errDtl.ERROR_CODE, codedErr.error_Desc from NYEHMS_PROCESS_ERRORS err, NYEHMS_PROCESS_ERRORS_DETAIL errDtl, CODED_PROCESS_ERRORS codedErr where err.document_id = #{documentId} and err.error_id = errDtl.error_id and active_flag= 'Y' and process_Status = 4 and codedErr.error_code = errDtl.ERROR_CODE
